bull_bear.body: The company's focus on sustainability and CSR initiatives is a non-obvious factor that sets it apart from its competitors.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet deleveraged to near-zero debt: long-term borrowings reduced to ₹0 by FY24 and short-term borrowings to ₹0 by FY25, with Debt-to-Equity at 0 in FY25 and FY26 (from 0.34 in FY23).
- Net worth grew from ₹34 Cr (FY21) to ₹186 Cr (FY26), alongside rising ROE (7.16%→12.96%) and ROCE (9.41%→17.58%) over FY23-FY26, indicating growth funded via equity/reserves rather than leverage.
- No dividend policy or explicit capex-funding plan is disclosed in the deck; expansion (metro tenders, new LED sites) appears funded from internal accruals given the debt-free position.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: The company's revenue is segmented into OOH advertising (67.34%), DOOH advertising (29.39%), and other services (3.27%)
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- India's first listed OOH company (BSE SME), with 45+ years of experience (trusted since 1980) and 5,000+ corporate clients across FMCG, tech, auto, real estate, entertainment, BFSI and healthcare.
- Holds exclusive/monopoly advertising rights in Navi Mumbai Metro, majority of Mumbai railway stations, and the Mumbai Port Trust (MbPT) Freeway.
- Truly 360-degree execution under one roof spanning OOH, DOOH, TV, print, radio, PR, events, digital/influencer marketing and celebrity management with an in-house creative & production team.
- Among India's largest Digital LED Billboard operators, having sold 1600 Lakh+ sq. ft. of prime hoarding space till 2025 and recognized as 'Great Indian IPO Game Changer' (2024).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body: - [Shareholding] Promoter & Promoter Group hold 70% and public shareholders hold 30% of the company (as on 11-06-2026).

deepdive.thesis: Bright Outdoor Media Limited is a leading player in India's OOH advertising market, with a strong presence in digital and traditional OOH advertising, and a growing portfolio of DOOH assets. The company has a diverse client base and a strong financial performance, with a revenue of ₹155 Cr and an EBITDA of ₹35 Cr in FY26. With its focus on innovation, digital transformation, and customer-centric strategies, Bright Outdoor Media is well-positioned to capitalize on the growing demand for OOH advertising in India.
